name: libgit2
description: A C library implementing the Git core methods with a solid API
TortoiseGit overlay of the stock vcpkg port. It layers the ext/libgit2-*.patch
series on top of upstream v1.9.4 and pins the backend selection to what
features are kept; the non-Windows TLS backends of the stock port are dropped.
This overlay is a temporary bridge and should be retired once the patches land

sha256.$note: Turns on EXPERIMENTAL_SHA256, which makes the installed git2/experimental.h define GIT_EXPERIMENTAL_SHA256=1 for every consumer.
